title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
content: The scheme is for Indian students studying in Class 11 or 12, diploma, degree or postgraduate courses. Students must have a benchmark disability of 40% or more.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
content: The official information lists a valid UDID Card and Aadhaar Card among the important requirements. Applicants should check the latest portal instructions for any additional documents.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
content: The official scheme information states a family income limit of up to Rs. 2.5 lakh per year.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
content: The scholarship is applied for online through the National Scholarship Portal. Scholarship payments are made through DBT/PFMS according to the applicable scheme process.
